purpose: Protected, tests-only schema-gate plan-binding acceptance handoff; not a standalone merge candidate
registration: Existing check.yml unittest discovery of scripts/ci/test_*.py; no workflow changes
boundary: Real gate __main__ entry points via runpy, isolated environment, real temporary artifact I/O; only subprocess.run is mocked

terminal_contract.code: stable lower_snake_case token; exact vocabulary chosen and documented by Builder
terminal_contract.next_action: nonempty stable remediation, independent of rejected values and exception text
terminal_contract.refusal_artifacts: absent or valid JSON with explicit failed/refused/error verdict or status; never a raw apparently clean report

observed_baseline.cause: Behavioral assertions: unbound reports accepted, invalid artifacts saved, missing terminal machine results, raw stderr/exception disclosure; not compile/cache/infrastructure refusal

builder_contract: Consume the published immutable handoff commit; preserve protected test bytes. Acceptance fixes remain with the test author.
Implement only the existing read-only evidence validation; preserve runner_version=1 and the Rust report shape. No new schema-version field, apply authority, bypass or waiver.
Update the pre-existing minimal-success gate fixtures to complete producer-shaped reports; retain both migration-chain checks, connection warnings and existing recovery exemptions.
Update concise gate contracts in docs/runbook.md and docs/production-deploy.md, including the terminal code vocabulary and remediation.
Own the combined passing PR, exact-head required CI, independent review and auto-merge. Do not merge the RED tests-only head.
not_run: required GitHub CI or independent review on the intentionally RED tests-only branch
